events.name: Elder Rosa
dialogue: Rosa: Ah, more strangers come to stare at our dying river.
Rosa: If you're bound for Whisperwind Field, look for the old shrine at its heart -- that's where the Blight is thickest.
Rosa: My grandmother said the shrine used to purify the land, before it went silent. Perhaps it can be woken again.
Rosa: Rest here as long as you need. Rivergate's gates are always open to the brave -- or the desperate.

events.name: Guard Yusuf
dialogue: Yusuf: Keep your blades sharp out there. We lost two patrols to wolves this month alone.
Yusuf: The General Store still has some stock left, if you're low on supplies.
